description.value:
A circular labyrinth is etched onto this tome's cover, its lines shimmering silver. Touching the book causes a sense of faint discombobulation.

Activate—Bewildering Walls f (concentrate, mental, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared wall spell, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Wall of Fire] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Wall of Thorns], you imbue the wall with an uncanny sense of disorientation, causing creatures to perceive it as an endless labyrinth. Any creature that begins its turn within the wall's spaces or passes through the wall's spaces must attempt a Will save against your spell DC, in addition to the wall's normal effect. Regardless of the results, the target then becomes immune to Bewildering Walls for 24 hours.

Critical Success The wall has no additional effect for that creature.

Success The creature is bewildered by its perceptions of labyrinthine walls and treats all other creatures as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed] for 1 round.

Failure The creature treats all other creatures as hidden for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature treats all other creatures as hidden for 1 round and concealed for 1 minute.
